facts.fact: A BCEAO communiqué of 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions to connect to PI-SPI, and 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions, across the eight UEMOA countries.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions

note: Senegal's 24 PI-SPI participants at 31 July 2026 is a switch count, not a fact.
